spans.s: शम्—मद् N. of an Āṅgirasa, PañcavBr. (cf. शाम्मद).
सम्-√ अद् P. -अत्ति, to eat completely up, entirely devour, Bhaṭṭ.

(prob. fr. 7. स + मद्, ‘raging together’; accord. to Yāska either fr. सम्-√ अद्, or fr. सम्-√ मद्; accord. to others fr. 2. सम् + suffix अद्; cf. स॑मन) strife, battle (often in loc. pl.; acc. with √ कृ or √ धा and dat., ‘to cause strife among or between’), RV.; AV.; Br.
(used to explain सम॑द्), Nir. ix, 17.
